---
applyTo: "apps/website/**"
---

# Website application

- This is the sales and marketing site, built with TanStack Start. Keep its responsibilities separate from the authenticated product app in `apps/web`.
- Define file-based routes in `src/routes/`. Treat `src/routeTree.gen.ts` as generated by the TanStack Router plugin; do not edit it by hand.
- The root route in `src/routes/__root.tsx` owns the document shell, Clerk provider, and shared stylesheet import. Keep shared UI styling sourced from `@condo-manager/ui`.
- `src/start.ts` configures Clerk request middleware and CSRF protection for server functions. Preserve these protections when changing server functions or middleware.
- Enforce authorization in server functions and protected server routes. A signed-in presentation state is not an authorization boundary.
- Keep secrets such as `CLERK_SECRET_KEY` server-only. Never expose them through `VITE_*` variables or commit them.
- Use base UI components from `@condo-manager/ui` and check its exports before introducing another component. If no existing base component fits, ask the user before creating a new reusable UI primitive; compose existing primitives for app-specific interfaces. Use shared Tailwind CSS v4 tokens and do not create a parallel theme or duplicate fixed visual styles in inline style objects.
- Use `pnpm` from the repository root. Relevant commands are `pnpm dev:website` and `pnpm --filter @condo-manager/website build`.
